list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM deployments ORDER BY 1

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND environment IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_branch
list.label: Trunk
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_branch FROM pull_requests WHERE project = '$project' AND target_branch IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: repository
list.label: Repository
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repository FROM pull_requests WHERE project = '$project' AND repository IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: pipeline
list.label: Pipeline
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT pipeline FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND pipeline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT area_path FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lead Time for Changes (PR merge median)
panels.description: Median PR created->merged hours to the trunk branch. DORA band: Elite <=24h, High <=1w, Medium <=1m.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/3600.0))::numeric, 1) AS "Lead time" FROM pull_requests WHERE project = '$project' AND status = 'completed' AND closed_at >= created_at AND target_branch = '$target_branch' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at)

panels.title: Deployment Frequency
panels.description: Successful deployments per week to the selected environment over the selected time range. DORA band: Elite >=7/wk, High >=1/wk, Medium >=0.25/wk.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE success AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)) / GREATEST(1.0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))/604800.0))::numeric, 2) AS "Deploys/week" FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND environment = '$environment' AND pipeline IN (${pipeline:sqlstring})

panels.title: Change Failure Rate
panels.description: Failed deployments / all attempted deployments to the selected environment (whole dataset, incl. attempts with no recorded timestamp). DORA band: Elite/High <=15%, Medium <=30%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "CFR" FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND environment = '$environment' AND pipeline IN (${pipeline:sqlstring})

panels.title: Mean Time to Restore
panels.description: Mean hours from a failed deployment to the next successful deployment of the same pipeline+env, for the selected environment. Shows 'n/a' when there are no failed deployments with a recorded timestamp. DORA band: Elite <1h, High <1d, Medium <1w.

targets.rawSql: WITH ev AS (SELECT pipeline_id, environment, finished_at, success FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND environment = '$environment' AND pipeline IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) AND finished_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (nxt - finished_at))/3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "MTTR" FROM (SELECT f.finished_at, (SELECT min(s.finished_at) FROM ev s WHERE s.pipeline_id = f.pipeline_id AND s.environment = f.environment AND s.success AND s.finished_at > f.finished_at) AS nxt FROM ev f WHERE NOT f.success) x WHERE nxt IS NOT NULL

SELECT date_trunc('week', finished_at) AS time, environment AS metric, count(*) FILTER (WHERE success) AS deploys FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lead time for changes (weekly median, hours)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', closed_at) AS time, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/3600.0))::numeric, 1) AS "p50 (median)", round((percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/3600.0))::numeric, 1) AS "p75" FROM pull_requests WHERE project = '$project' AND status = 'completed' AND closed_at >= created_at AND target_branch = '$target_branch' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', finished_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE success) AS "success", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS "fail", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "CFR %" FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND environment = '$environment' AND pipeline IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT finished_at AS "time", pipeline, stage, environment, result, branch, url FROM deployments WHERE project = '$project' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND pipeline IN (${pipeline:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Defect inflow
panels.description: New bugs created per week over the selected time range, for the selected area(s). Lower is better (no official DORA band): <1/wk low inflow, <5/wk moderate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)) / GREATEST(1.0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))/604800.0))::numeric, 2) AS "New bugs/week" FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring})

panels.title: Open backlog (now)
panels.description: Bugs currently unresolved (no resolved/closed date) for the selected area(s). Point-in-time, not affected by the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Open bugs" FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND resolved_at IS NULL

panels.title: Bug recovery time (median)
panels.description: Median hours from bug created -> resolved, for bugs resolved in the selected time range and area(s). A labelled restore proxy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at))/3600.0))::numeric, 1) AS "Recovery" FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= created_at AND $__timeFilter(resolved_at)

panels.title: Bugs in window
panels.description: Bugs created within the selected time range and area(s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Bugs" FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, regexp_replace(area_path, '^[^\\]*\\', '') AS metric, count(*) AS bugs FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT regexp_replace(area_path, '^[^\\]*\\', '') AS area, count(*) AS bugs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NULL) AS open, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= created_at THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at))/3600.0 END)))::numeric, 1) AS "median recovery (h)" FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: PR throughput — merged PRs per week (by repository)
panels.description: Completed pull requests per week (SPACE: Activity / delivery volume). Team-level signal; pair with lead time so volume is not rewarded over flow. Filtered by Repository.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', closed_at) AS time, repository AS metric, count(*) AS merged FROM pull_requests WHERE project = '$project' AND status = 'completed' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(closed_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: PR abandonment rate (weekly)
panels.description: Share of PRs abandoned vs (completed + abandoned), by the week the PR was opened. A waste / churn signal (unclear requirements, scope changes, review friction). Filtered by Repository.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'abandoned') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed','abandoned')), 0), 1) AS "abandonment %" FROM pull_requests WHERE project = '$project' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bug inflow vs outflow (weekly)
panels.description: Bugs opened vs resolved per week. Inflow persistently above outflow means the defect backlog is growing. Filtered by Area.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wk AS time, sum(opened) AS "opened", sum(closed) AS "resolved" FROM (SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS wk, 1 AS opened, 0 AS closed FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('week', resolved_at), 0, 1 FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL) x WHERE $__timeFilter(wk) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Open bug backlog over time
panels.description: Cumulative unresolved bugs at each week (Flow Load / WIP for defects). Running sum of opened minus resolved across all history, so the trend is exact. Filtered by Area.

targets.rawSql: WITH ev AS (SELECT created_at AS ts, 1 AS d FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) UNION ALL SELECT resolved_at, -1 FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT wk AS time, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY wk) AS "open backlog" FROM (SELECT date_trunc('week', ts) AS wk, sum(d) AS delta FROM ev WHERE ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) w ORDER BY wk

panels.title: Bug resolution time by severity
panels.description: Median and p75 days from bug created -> resolved, per severity, for bugs resolved in the selected time range and area(s). Shows whether high-severity defects are prioritised. Filtered by Area.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(severity, ''), '(unset)') AS severity, count(*) AS resolved, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at))/86400.0))::numeric, 1) AS "median days", round((percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at))/86400.0))::numeric, 1) AS "p75 days" FROM bugs WHERE project = '$project' AND area_path IN (${area:sqlstring}) AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= created_at AND $__timeFilter(resolved_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
